name: Gooey Audio Player
description: Centered play/pause button over a background image. Blobby gooey particles orbit the button while audio plays, and the icon morphs between play and pause.
contents: Full-screen background image with dark overlay
Round gooey play/pause button with four corner particles and morphing icon
behavior: While playing the button spins, particles drift and the color switches to the active color
Icon path animates between play and pause shapes
editableByProps: Audio source, background image and overlay class

needsCodeEdit.where: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation in the fancy-goo filter
particle-1 to particle-4 keyframes in the style block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
